TENNIS:ten.retirement_timing_profile.reason: RET/DEF parsed from score string; retiring player = loser; interrupted-set games parsed, missing ones censored as specified. Historical rows only; fully computable.

TENNIS:ten.home_slam_depth_prior.history: ATP 79,019 / WTA 72,434 main-tour rows 2000-2026-04; serve stats ATP 91% / WTA 66% (SvGms WTA 38%)
TENNIS:ten.home_slam_depth_prior.reason: Round reached from round+winner/loser; nation from ioc; host nation of the 4 majors is a static constant. Last 15 editions available (26 yrs).

TENNIS:ten.protected_ranking_and_entry_p.reason: No protected-ranking value/expiry, no entry-list/cutoff data, no wildcard grants by status; entry codes only mark who played, not who was refused/withdrew. Needs tour announcements/entry lists.

TENNIS:ten.bo5_rating_premium.reason: Bo5 matches (ATP Slams, Davis) tagged by best_of; Elo walk-forward from results; residuals over prior 60 bo5 matches. Sparse per player but shrunk n_eff/(n_eff+25); WTA has no bo5.

TENNIS:ten.major_winner_concentration.reason: Final winners at level G give last 12 majors; HHI/top-2 share direct; updates after each major.

TENNIS:ten.career_major_count_state.reason: Data start 2000, so career counts miss pre-2000 titles (e.g. S. Williams 1999 USO, Sampras, Agassi, Graf); snapshot ends 2026-04-22 so RG/Wimb/USO 2026 absent. Needs static pre-2000 title list plus refresh.

TENNIS:ten.hold_gap_expected_margin.reason: Opponent-adjusted spw from own serve and opponent return (opponent svpt/won), 12m half-life, hold closed form, set DP; all from prior matches. Set-count distribution from score.

TENNIS:ten.retirement_margin_state.reason: Games at stoppage parsed from RET scores; retiring side = loser; D by tour; pooled shrinkage. P(D>1.5|ret) directly estimable.

TENNIS:ten.hold_rate_uncertainty_propaga.reason: Beta posterior with effective n from svpt aged by tourney_date (24m, cap 4000); simulation/DP is computation only. Prior-day data.
